I haven't changed anything. The page's design rules block this change, and the date in the message is also wrong.

## 1. The date doesn't match

Today is Friday 16 October 2026, so **20 October 2026 is a Tuesday**. The nearest Sunday is **18 October**. Which is right: Sunday 18 October or Tuesday 20 October?

## 2. The Design Kit has no banner

The Design Kit is the copy of your design system stored in `design-kit/`. The project rules say all UI must be copied from it value by value. If it lacks a component, variant or state, I have to stop and ask you to add it to the kit rather than make one up.

Right now the kit has only:
- `tokens.css`: background, surface, text and primary (green `#2f5d50`) colours, one corner radius (8px), two spacing sizes (8px and 16px), and one font.
- `components/button.html`: a primary button.
- `components/card.html`: a white card with padding and a light shadow.

A dismissible warning banner needs three things the kit doesn't have:

| Missing piece | Why it's needed |
|---|---|
| **Warning colours** (background, text, maybe border) | The kit's only accent is the brand green. A warning in green wouldn't read as a warning. |
| **Banner/alert component** (layout, padding, how it sits at the top of the page) | Only Card exists. A card styled as a banner would be an improvised variant. |
| **Close control** (icon or text button, size, hover/focus states) | The only button is the large green primary one, which is wrong for a small "×". |

**My recommendation:** add an "Alert / warning" component to the Design Kit, with its colour tokens and a close button, and re-export `design-kit/`. Once that's in, I'll copy it value by value and add the dismiss behaviour (a few lines of JavaScript, with no new dependency).

Two smaller points for when I build it:
- Should dismissal last across page reloads (saved in the browser), or only until the next reload?
- `main` is the current branch, so I'll work on a separate branch. Which Linear issue ID should the commit reference?
